prompt: Two reference images are attached: the first is Hive's real desktop app, whose layout, content, icons, bee mascot and type must stay; the second is Linear's home page, which is the reference for the flat visual language only (hairline dividers, flat fills, tiny quiet metadata, plain text sidebar, no shadows, no glass, no blur, no gradients, no floating rounded cards). The second image's content and branding are not to be copied. Palette: deep green-black ground, regions #0B1310, #0F1915, #13201A, hairlines #1F3027, so green is clearly the ground. Honey #F2B632 for the send button, links and the needs-review chip and card edge; soft sage text #A9CDB6 for the active channel.
